rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): in his instruction to Huixin Zhao, Zhuanyu Guanheng says that merely memorizing abstruse sayings, even eloquently enough to make a stubborn stone nod, has no connection at all with one's own share.

rows.Kwic: 病僧每飯罷經行時，見子事眾畢方就飯堂
rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): referring to himself as the sick monk in his instruction to Wanbai Hao, Zhuanyu Guanheng recounts walking in meditation after meals and observing Hao's consistently careful service and eating routine.

rows.Kwic: 當時釋迦拈花何等直捷？迦葉微笑何等快便？
rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): inside Zhuanyu Guanheng's instruction to Kuanju Yong, Shakyamuni Buddha is the exact actor who holds up the flower, paired with Mahakasyapa's smile as a direct and rapid exchange.

rows.Kwic: 隱者出巖外經行，師亦隨之，第東西各步。
rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): in the biography of Hanshan Deqing, an unnamed hermit living in a rock shelter goes outside at night to walk in meditation; Hanshan follows and the two walk separately east and west. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and parallel-passage search do not give a personal name for the unnamed rock-hermit.

rows.Kwic: 上下虛明如大圓鏡相似，入室取《楞嚴經》證之。開卷見「汝身汝心，外及山河、虛空大地咸是妙明真心中物。」
rows.sourceTitle: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Zhuanyu Heng at Purple Bamboo Grove (紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄): the biography of Hanshan Deqing recounts that after a night of walking meditation at Laoshan, Hanshan enters his room and takes up the Surangama Sutra to test the luminous, mirror-like experience against its words.
